name: Protopasta PLA
filament_notes:
Covers Back to Basics PLA and Recycled PLA.
Material Data Table: 220C up to 6 mm3/s, 240C up to 12 mm3/s, 55C plate. This profile uses 220C with a 12 mm3/s cap - raise toward 240C when printing near the cap. Getting-started page: 195-225C nozzle, 50-60C bed.
Proto-Pasta finds PLA normally prints fine without drying; if you do dry it, stay below 50C.
